text:
پھگن گیا ترے ٹھوک ونجا۔
گل لگنا، تل چبنا، پہننا کپاہ۔
romanized:
Phaggaṇ geā tré thok vanjā.
Gal laggṇā, til chabbṇā, pahinṇā kapāh.
literal_en:
Phaggan has destroyed (the pleasure of) three things—
Sleeping in each other's arms, chewing sesamum, and wearing quilted clothes.
meaning_en: i.e., it has become too hot.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses

meaning_pa: پھگن ترے سکھ کھوہ لیندا اے: گل لگ کے سونا، تل چبنے تے روں والے کپڑے پاونے؛ یعنی گرمی چڑھ جاندی اے۔
